ios.desc:
A cute mascot that reminds you to take your medications & supplements on time. But watch out: he gets increasingly annoying if you miss a dose!

Pill Buddy is a fun, friendly pill tracker that helps build healthy habits through gentle reminders, playful rewards, and a mascot that actually cares. Inspired by the Japanese daruma, this expressive little companion reacts to every missed or taken dose — from smiles and cheers to hilariously guilt-inducing frowns.

Features:
• Choose from push notifications, phone calls, and widgets to stay on track
• Record dose time and quantity, add one-off doses, or skip meds you don't need
• Add optional notes to your med doses, and track your blood pressure and weight
• Build streaks and earn stars for taking meds on time
• Personalize your mascot with fun items & accessories
• No ads, and your personal info stays private and protected

Whether you’re managing a chronic condition or just trying to remember to take your vitamins, Pill Buddy brings warmth, motivation, and a small dose of fun to every day.

------

Hi everyone! I was most recently a PM at a large-ish tech company for 6+ years, but I decided it was time to strike out and do something on my own as an indie developer.

I built an iOS app to help people like myself track their medicines & supplements. It's called Pill Buddy, and its designed to be a cute way to remember to take your meds. Please let me know what you think!
